services.desc: Skip the crowded streets, impossible parking, and packed wharves to watch the sky ignite from the tranquility of Newport Harbor. There is no better way to experience the Navy’s “Salute to Summer” than with a front-row seat on a classic sailing yacht. Enjoy breathtaking, unobstructed panoramic views of the season’s most spectacular fireworks display, surrounded by the beauty of the illuminated coastline. Step aboard as the evening cools, setting the perfect stage for a memorable night on Narragansett Bay.
